The '''Pzandias system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pzandias/Legends|Pzandias]].
